hypothesis: A detector-free matcher can provide ground correspondences on unmarked roads whose tiled DISK graph is disconnected.

matcher.pretrained_training_source: MegaDepth; overlap with evaluation locations unknown
matcher.masking: Zero excluded RGB before grayscale/crop/resampling and inference. Use eroded valid masks in attention; retain only allowed output coordinates.
matcher.weights_policy: Explicit local checkpoint with pinned SHA256, no constructor download
matcher.geometry: Existing propose_edge, fit_graph, fit_metric_graph and audit_poses unchanged; no support expansion

evaluation.projection: Existing frozen nadir masks and dimensions
evaluation.truth: No ground truth beneath real car; donor agreement is not accuracy
evaluation.promotion: none until actual end-to-end controls pass
evaluation.preflight: Three excluded-pixel perturbations per region; require identical full model inputs. Unsafe resize-before-mask control must detect leakage.

license_notes: Kornia documentation and original LoFTR repository identify Apache-2.0 code; checkpoint model card separately labels its weights MIT. Retain both source attributions.
remaining_validation: Coordinate convention with known synthetic transform and loaded weights
Spatially correlated dense matches require spatial-heldout diagnostics before promotion
